paper_title: Axion dark matter: strings and their cores
notes: Theoretical/cosmological simulation study of axion string-wall network evolution and axion production efficiency. It yields a single prediction fa = 3.3e11 GeV, ma = 18 ueV (K=8), not an exclusion limit or coupling constraint. No coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve is presented, so no data points to extract. The AxionMass hint refers to the fa-ma relation but this is a point prediction, not a bound. | Coupling from pre-classifier (AxionMass, conf=0.95)
